title: 第9章 师父来访第10章 蒙面再现
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
敲闷棍的自然就是秦峰，他将商世杰储物戒中的灵石还有几张符纸全部收走。
然后迅速消失不见，还是这种零投入的生意好做呀。
秦峰最后给出了一句评价：“小胖子，好人啊！”
回到了自己的小院，发现师妹已经离开了，屋内还留有淡淡的少女清香。
他在院子中支起了火锅，拿出了一些灵兽肉切片，这几天收获颇丰，应该奖励一下自己。
拿出了之前还剩的半壶梨花醉，喝着小酒，涮着火锅，美滋滋啊！
影剑峰山脚下，过了好半天，商世杰才幽幽醒来，后脑还有一些痛。
他醒来以后第一时间就是检查自己的储物戒指，丹药还在，自己平时卖的货物还在。
他的心放下了一半，再检查灵石，灵石呢？
反复检查了几遍，发现储物戒中一块灵石都没有了，他愤怒道：“那个挨千刀的，我不会放过你的！”
他飞快的来到了执法殿。
这件事必须上报，万一是其他宗或者是魔族的奸细，汇报晚了对方可就跑了。
他辛辛苦苦骗来的，不对，是赚来的钱，可就打水漂了。
此刻楼万里正在为之前赔了八十万而郁闷呢。
下面的袁武低眉顺眼的不敢吭声。
商世杰来到执法殿道：“二师伯，我怀疑咱们宗门有奸细，我被打劫了四十万灵石。”
楼万里道：“发生了什么事？”
商世杰将事情的来龙去脉说了一遍。
楼万里眉头一蹙：“你说你只是看到一个蒙面人？”
商世杰愤怒道：“对方出手太快了，稳准狠，至少是金丹修为。”

“要不然我不可能没有丝毫的还手之力，而且……”
楼万里不耐烦道：“有什么话快说，你提供的每一个信息都有助于我们抓到凶手。”
商世杰有些不确定道：“虽然对方用的是木棍，但我看对方的手法很像剑道。”
“而且已经妙到毫巅，把我打晕的同时，又没有对我造成损伤。”
楼万里道：“你过来，我看看你被打的部位！”
商世杰来到近前，楼万里检查了一番道：“对方确实无意伤你，也没有被搜魂的痕迹。”
“排除魔族奸细的可能性，看来单纯就是为了求财，你是筑基巅峰，却毫无还手之力，说明对方至少是金丹修为。”
“袁武，带十名执法殿弟子彻查所有现在还在宗门的金丹期以上弟子。
尤其是最近比较缺钱的人。”
商世杰躬身一礼道：“多谢二师伯！”
楼万里一摆手道：“你回去等消息吧！”
接下来，整个宗门被闹得鸡飞狗跳，执法队到各个峰去盘查弟子。
杀剑峰上，秦峰并不知道外面发生的一切，他此刻正在喝着小酒唱的歌，一边涮着小火锅。
正开心呢，院外传来一个冰冷的声音：“你倒是挺潇洒呀！”
话音未落，穆无双推开院子的栅栏门走了进来，毫不客气的坐在秦峰对面。
拿起筷子夹了一片火锅里的肉片放在嘴里，满意的点点头。
“味道不错！
你小子修炼慢如龟爬，没想到鼓捣这些东西倒是挺在行。”
秦峰尴尬一笑道：“师父，你今天怎么这么有空来我这里？”
content_en:
The one who knocked the sap was naturally Qin Feng, who took away all the spirit stones and several talismans in Shang Shijie's storage ring.
Then it disappears quickly. This kind of zero-investment business is still easy to do.
Qin Feng gave his last comment: "Little fat guy, what a good person!"
When I returned to my small courtyard, I found that my junior sister had left, and there was still a faint girlish fragrance in the house.
He set up a hot pot in the yard and took out some slices of spirit animal meat. He had gained a lot these past few days and should reward himself.
I took out the half-pot of Lihua Zui left before, drank some wine, and cooked the hot pot. It was so delicious!
At the foot of Shadow Sword Peak, it took a long time before Shang Shijie woke up faintly, still feeling some pain in the back of his head.
After he woke up, the first thing he checked was his storage ring. The elixir was still there, and the goods he usually sold were still there.
He was half relieved and checked the spirit stone again. Where is the spirit stone?
After checking several times, he found that there was no spiritual stone in the storage ring. He said angrily: "I won't let you go, the one who suffered a thousand cuts!"
He quickly arrived at the Law Enforcement Hall.
This matter must be reported. If it is a spy from another sect or the demon clan, the other party will run away if the report is late.
The money he had worked so hard to cheat, no, it was money he earned, but it was wasted.
At this moment, Lou Wanli was feeling depressed because he had lost 800,000 yuan before.
Yuan Wu below lowered his eyebrows and did not dare to say a word.
Shang Shijie came to the law enforcement hall and said: "Second Senior Uncle, I suspect that there is a spy in our sect. I was robbed of 400,000 spiritual stones."
Lou Wanli asked: "What happened?"
Shang Shijie told the whole story.
Lou Wanli frowned: "You said you just saw a masked man?"
Shang Shijie said angrily: "The opponent's attack was too fast, accurate and ruthless, at least with the golden elixir cultivation level."
"Otherwise I wouldn't be able to fight back at all, and..."
Lou Wanli said impatiently: "If you have anything to say, tell me quickly. Every information you provide will help us catch the murderer."
Shang Shijie said with some uncertainty: "Although the other party used a wooden stick, I think the other party's technique is very similar to kendo."
"And it was so wonderful that it knocked me unconscious without causing any damage to me."
Lou Wanli said: "Come here, let me see where you were beaten!"
Shang Shijie came closer, Lou Wanli checked it out and said, "The other party did not intend to hurt you, and there are no traces of soul searching."
"Excluding the possibility of a demon spy, it seems that you are simply seeking money. You are at the peak of foundation building, but you have no power to fight back, which means that the other party is at least a golden elixir cultivation level."
"Yuan Wu, lead ten disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall to thoroughly investigate all the disciples who are still in the sect at the Golden Core stage or above.
Especially those who are short of money recently. "
Shang Shijie bowed and said, "Thank you so much, Second Senior Uncle!"
Lou Wanli waved his hand and said, "Go back and wait for the news!"
Next, the entire sect was in uproar, and the law enforcement team went to various peaks to interrogate the disciples.
On the Killing Sword Peak, Qin Feng didn't know what was happening outside. He was drinking wine and singing while making a small hot pot.
Just when I was happy, a cold voice came from outside the hospital: "You are quite chic!"
Before he finished speaking, Mu Wushuang pushed open the fence door of the yard and walked in, sitting opposite Qin Feng unceremoniously.
He picked up the chopsticks, picked up a piece of meat from the hot pot, put it in his mouth, and nodded with satisfaction.
“It tastes good!
You kid is as slow as a turtle in cultivation. I didn't expect that you are quite good at tinkering with these things. "
Qin Feng smiled awkwardly and said, "Master, why are you so free to come to my place today?"
